* Exceptional attention to detail, accuracy, organizational, interpersonal, and teamwork skills
* Excellent financial, communication, and interpersonal skills as well as an elevated level of personal motivation to achieve
* Demonstrated ability to work with confidential and sensitive data
* Effective time management and prioritization skills, to manage multiple projects or tasks simultaneously
* Able to perform in depth analysis using various sources of information
* Able to meet deliverable timelines set by the client, project team and company
* Understands the underlying principles of revenue recognition and the relationship between Revenue, Backlog, Work in process and Invoicing
* Ability to travel \<10%

jobs.title: Supply Chain Sr Staff Contracts Analyst
jobs.description:
**Standard Job Description**
----------------------------



Our Missiles and Fire Control (MFC) Southeast Material Acquisition Center (SEMAC) Supply Chain team is passionate about delivering innovative, affordable, and agile solutions that exceed our customer’s expectations. The supply chain team touches every product and service we deliver and enables our customers to do the impossible every day. We leverage problem solving, creativity, and data to tackle the most exciting challenges in the industry.  

  

Our people are some of the greatest minds in the industry and truly make Lockheed Martin a great place to work.

  

You have arrived at your career destination\~ Join us!

 **Who You Are**  

As a Global Supply Chain Sr Staff Contracts Analyst, you are an experienced professional with a legal, contracts or supply chain management background. You have a comprehensive understanding of the FAR and DFARS with extensive supplier management experience including negotiations and subcontract terms and conditions. You are very comfortable working without appreciable direction and are skilled at providing specialized guidance on contract terms and conditions, regulations, contracting strategies, and other contract matters.  

  

**What You Will Be Doing**  

In this highly visible and fast paced role, the selected candidate will be responsible for advocating for the best interests of the company in contract negotiations and administration, ensuring compliance to policies and regulations, mitigating risk, and partnering with others to obtain positive business results.

  

In this role, you will:

* Manage, review, approve, negotiate, and provide guidance on subcontract terms and conditions for commercial, construction, DOD and international programs, including but not limited to FAR/DFARS requirements, Corporate Documents, End User License Agreements, standard text keys, bailment agreements, economic price adjustment clauses, and model contracts for the procurement of specialized materials, equipment, and services for subcontract systems in support of development, production and global sustainment primes with multiple contract types
* Interpret and understand regulations and contract language to ensure compliance, resolve conflicts, address policy and procedure issues
* Identify, develop, and maintain processes, tools, training and other resources for the benefit of the organization
* Support the mitigation of risks, issues, and opportunities related to contract terms and conditions
* Assists and advises multifunctional subcontract management teams on terms and conditions and subcontract administration issues.
* Provides contract analysis to Global Supply Chain to assist in supplier disclosures, pursuit of remedies, and potential disputes.
* Interface internally and externally with Global Supply Chain, Legal, Contracts, Price/Cost Analysis, and other functional areas at all levels of the organization
**Basic Qualifications**
------------------------


* Bachelors degree from an accredited college or university
* Supplier negotiation experience
* Experience with US Government Contracting and the FAR and DFARS
**Desired Skills**
------------------


* Master's degree in a related field and/or Law Degree (JD)
* Experienced and effective communicator (written, verbal and presentation)
* Demonstrated ability to communicate complicated subject matter succinctly to stakeholders and executives
* Demonstrated ability to prioritize effectively and operate efficiently under constrained timelines with multiple priorities
* Experience working for a large defense contractor
* Experience in regulatory compliance, contracts, or supply chain management
* Experience analyzing, resolving, and negotiating supplier exceptions to terms and conditions
* Experience in Federal procurement law and the Uniform Commercial Code (UCC)
* Experience with Solutions Business Manager (SBM) or similar Contracts Management system
* Claims, disputes, disclosures, or remedy experience
* DOD Secret Clearance

	+ Includes metropolitan areas such as Sunnyvale CA; Pal Alto, CA; New York City metropolitan area; Newark, New Jersey; etc.
* Full\-time salary range (GEOZONE 2\): $123400\.00 \- $229200\.00
	+ Includes metropolitan areas such as Denver, CO; King of Prussia, PA; Stratford, CT; Moorestown, NJ; etc.
* Full\-time salary range (GEOZONE 3\): $109700\.00 \- $203700\.00
	+ Includes metropolitan areas such as Dallas–Fort Worth, TX; Orlando, FL; Grand Prairie, TX; Marietta, GA; etc.

jobs.title: Financial Analyst - Inventory Reconciliation
jobs.description:
Overview:

Intrepid, an SPA Company, brings more than 20 years of experience supporting the Department of Defense and U.S. Government, consistently setting the standard for excellence in the federal marketplace. Committed to advancing the mission of the U.S. Warfighter, Intrepid leverages technological superiority to deliver innovative solutions across air, space, land, and sea domains. We are proud to foster a collaborative, dynamic work environment, offering competitive compensation and an industry\-leading 401k contribution. Our team is built through merit and achievement, and we’re always looking for the best and brightest to join us in our growth. We treat our people like family, we are mission\-focused, and we give back! Join us today.  

SPA has an immediate need for a Financial Analyst\-Inventory Reconciliation.
Responsibilities:

The position focuses on delivering Department of Work (DoW)\-wide inventory reconciliations within Advana or Palantir Foundry to enable accurate financial reporting and audit readiness, including valuation assessments and General Ledger (GL) tie\-outs. This involves creating robust inventory reconciliations for each Working Capital Fund (WCF) DoW agency using advanced data platforms. Key responsibilities include reconciling subledger\-to\-GL tie\-points by mapping quantities, values, and financial line items, as well as tracking Work\-in\-Process (WIP) and in\-transit inventory items to ensure comprehensive oversight. The scope also includes managing inter\-agency transfers, such as handling denials and returns, and establishing traceability to source transactions for improved accountability. Additionally, the role requires harmonizing master data elements like material numbers, Unit Identification Codes (UICs), storage locations, and condition codes to achieve consistency across systems. A critical aspect of this effort is identifying unmatched or unreconciled balances, categorizing them with age buckets and root\-cause codes, and proposing workflow\-driven corrective actions to address discrepancies. This initiative is integral to enhancing inventory management, financial transparency, and operational efficiency across the DoW enterprise.  


Qualifications:
**Required Qualifications:*** Bachelor's Degree
* At least 3 years experience in Subledger\-to\-General Ledger
* At least 5 years experience identifying unmatched/unreconciled balances
* Experience with Advana/Foundry environments
* Active SECRET Clearance and the ability to maintain it throughout employment

Elements of the compensation package include competitive base pay and variable compensation opportunities. jobs.description:
Under the general supervision of the Cash Management Supervisor, this position is responsible for analyzing, monitoring, preparing, and reconciling financial information to support the administration and control of contract and grant operations. The position prepares and submits expense reimbursement and cash drawdown requests through multiple federal payment systems and monitors related activity through completion.
  

  

Responsibilities include preparing reimbursement and drawdown documentation; monitoring cash receipts and payments; recording and reconciling related financial transactions; identifying and resolving discrepancies; and preparing required quarterly financial reports. The position applies accounting principles, financial concepts, and a strong understanding of accounting practices, campus policies, procedures, and sponsor requirements to analyze financial data and documentation and ensure accurate and timely processing of invoices, payment collections, reimbursement requests, and cash drawdowns.
  

  

The position independently reviews transactions and supporting documentation, evaluates a variety of financial factors, and exercises judgment to identify issues, determine appropriate corrective action, and escalate matters when necessary. The position works regularly with fund managers and unit leads to resolve financial and administrative issues and maintains limited external contact with sponsors and administrators of federal payment systems.

  

**Apply By Date**


**10/07/2026 by 11:59 pm**

  

**Qualifications**


**Minimum Qualifications \- For full consideration, applicants are encouraged to upload license and/or certification if required of the position**


* Bachelor's degree or equivalent of 3\-6 years of experience in a business or finance position.
* Demonstrated experience in the use of spreadsheet and database software in financial analysis, fiscal management and financial reports, including advanced functions.
* Experience in a busy, high\-volume, and deadline driven work environment that requires coordination of multiple activities and the judgment and flexibility to re\-prioritize to accommodate emergency requests.
* Solid understanding of general financial administrative principles and knowledge of generally accepted accounting principles as it relates to contract and grant administration.
* Demonstrated skills to thrive in a busy, high\-volume, and deadline driven work environment that requires coordination of multiple activities and the judgment and flexibility to re\-prioritize to accommodate emergency requests.
* Understanding of research administration guidelines of Federal and non\-Federal sponsors supporting research and educational activities, preferably in a university environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**


* CFRA (Certified Research Administrator) or equivalent.
* Knowledge of UC policies and procedures and experience applying them.
* Experience in the management of grants and contracts (preferred UC policies).Experience with enterprise level financial systems.
  

**Key Responsibilities**


* 45% \- Cash Management
* 30% \- Cash Application
* 20% \- Accounts Receivable Management
* 5% \- Other Duties
  

**Department Overview**


Contracts and Grants Accounting (CGA) has campus\-wide responsibility for the financial administration of all contract and grant funding received by UC Davis. In fiscal year 2026, this funding generated approximately $908 million in revenue from governmental and private contracts and grants.
  

  

CGA provides comprehensive post\-award financial administration and support to the Davis campus, including initial fund setup, financial reporting, ongoing financial analysis and reconciliation, interpretation and implementation of University and sponsor policies, collection of reimbursable expenditures through billing and federal cash drawdown processes, and contract and grant closeout activities.
  

  

CGA also has campus\-wide responsibility for coordinating and supporting the Single Audit of contracts and grants, as well as cooperating with federal and other external audits. This includes participating in the preparation of responses to audit findings and implementing corrective actions necessary to address and resolve audit issues.
  

  

CGA develops and maintains the systems, policies, procedures, and training necessary to support the effective financial administration of approximately 4,800 contracts and grants across campus. jobs.description:
**THE POSITION**
----------------

  

  

Are you an analytical, organized, and collaborative professional who enjoys turning information into solutions and supporting programs that directly impact the community? The City of Rancho Cordova is seeking a **Management Analyst I/II** to join the Neighborhood Services Department!
  

In this role, you will provide analytical, financial, and administrative support across a diverse portfolio of Neighborhood Services programs, including **Code Enforcement, Animal Services, Parking Enforcement, Rental Housing, Homeless Outreach, and Emergency Preparedness**. You will work closely with staff and management to support budgets and financial activities, analyze program data, administer contracts and grants, prepare professional reports, and help move important programs and projects forward.
  

  

This position provides an excellent opportunity for an analyst who wants exposure to a variety of municipal operations while contributing to programs that help maintain safe, strong, and vibrant neighborhoods throughout Rancho Cordova.
  

  

**About the Role**
  

As a **Management Analyst I/II**, you'll play an important role in supporting the day\-to\-day and long\-term operations of Neighborhood Services. Your assignments will combine financial management, data analysis, contract and grant administration, research, reporting, and project coordination.
  

  

Key responsibilities include:
* **Manage financial and budget activities** for Neighborhood Services programs, including processing and tracking financial transactions, assisting with division and program budgets, and supporting financial reporting.
* **Collect, analyze, and report program data and performance metrics**, developing statistical reports and tracking information that helps management evaluate program performance and make informed decisions.
* **Support contract and grant administration**, including drafting contracts, monitoring financial activity, and providing ongoing contract management and administrative support.
* **Prepare professional reports and management analyses**, including staff reports, operational reports, financial reports, and management studies for departmental and City leadership.
* **Provide analytical and administrative support** across Neighborhood Services programs, including Code Enforcement, Animal Services, Parking Enforcement, Rental Housing, Homeless Outreach, and Emergency Preparedness.
* **Lead assigned programs and special projects**, coordinating work across staff and stakeholders while developing increased responsibility for program management and operational initiatives.

**The Ideal Candidate**
  

The ideal candidate is a **well\-rounded, highly organized professional** who combines strong analytical and financial skills with the ability to understand and support diverse municipal operations.
You are someone who can move comfortably between analyzing a spreadsheet, monitoring a budget or contract, researching an issue, preparing a report, and coordinating with staff or stakeholders to keep a project moving forward. You are detail\-oriented and dependable, but also able to see the bigger picture and understand how data, finances, programs, and operations work together.


The successful candidate will:
* Demonstrate strong analytical, research, and problem\-solving skills.
* Be comfortable working with financial information, budgets, data, and performance measures.
* Possess strong organizational and project management skills and effectively manage competing priorities and deadlines.
* Communicate clearly and professionally, both verbally and in writing.
* Build effective working relationships with staff, management, contractors, community partners, and other City departments.
* Exercise sound judgment, initiative, and attention to detail.
* Be adaptable and interested in learning about a variety of Neighborhood Services programs and municipal operations.
* Be comfortable taking ownership of assignments and, as experience develops, leading programs and special projects.

Experience with municipal government, budget and financial analysis, data reporting, contract or grant administration, project management, and Microsoft Excel is highly desirable.  

  

  

**APPLY TODAY!** Take the next step in your career and help support programs that make a direct difference in Rancho Cordova's neighborhoods.

* Choice of a generous monthly stipend for Medical/Dental/Vision or Cash in Lieu of Medical Insurance.
* 13 paid holidays per year
* Universal Time Off (combined vacation and sick leave).
* CalPERS Retirement.

This position drives data\-driven decision\-making across budgets, reporting, and financial analysis, supporting the company's growth. jobs.description:
Valley Fruit \& Produce Company is seeking an experienced Senior Financial Analyst to join our Finance team and serve as a key financial partner to company leadership and operations.

For more than 100 years, Valley has operated in the fresh produce and food distribution industry. As our business continues to expand its food\-service operations, including our growing K\-12 school nutrition business, we are looking for a hands\-on finance professional who understands the unique financial and operational challenges of a perishable inventory environment.

This is not a purely desk\-based FP\&A position. The successful candidate will be comfortable working closely with operations, sales, accounting, and executive leadership to understand what is happening in the business and translate operational activity into meaningful financial analysis.

**What You'll Do**

**What We're Looking For**

**Key Responsibilities**

· Review and analyze daily, weekly, and monthly financial and operational KPIs across all areas of the business.

· Analyze revenue, units sold, gross margin, product costs, labor, overtime, freight, warehouse costs, and operating expenses to identify the drivers behind financial performance.

· Identify and explain trends, significant variances, risks, and opportunities based on financial and operational data.

· Perform detailed profitability analysis by customer, product, category, sales representative, route, business unit, and sales channel.

· Compare actual performance against budget, forecast, prior year, prior periods, and established targets, identifying and explaining material variances.

· Develop and maintain financial dashboards and KPI reporting that provide management with clear visibility into business performance.

· Analyze inventory performance and working\-capital metrics, including inventory turns, DSO, DPO, DIO, and Cash Conversion Cycle.

· Perform customer profitability and cost\-to\-serve analysis, incorporating product margin, freight, labor, delivery costs, credits, and other relevant costs.

· Build financial models and scenario analyses to evaluate changes in volume, pricing, product costs, labor, freight, and other business drivers.

· Support forecasting, budgeting, Annual Operating Plan (AOP), and long\-range planning (LRP) through financial analysis and modeling.

· Partner with Sales, Operations, Purchasing, Transportation, Warehouse, and other departments to understand operational results and quantify their financial impact.

· Identify opportunities to improve gross margin, cost efficiency, productivity, and working capital through data\-driven analysis.

· Prepare financial analysis and presentations for executive management, clearly communicating key findings, business drivers, risks, and opportunities.

· Perform ad hoc financial and operational analysis to support management decision\-making.

Position Focus

The Financial Analyst is responsible for converting financial and operational data into actionable business insights. The role focuses on performance analysis, KPIs, profitability, forecasting support, financial modeling, and decision support.

Accounting ownership, month\-end close, reconciliations, financial statement preparation, accounting policies, internal controls, audits, and compliance remain under the Controller and Accounting functions.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 5–8\+ years of progressive experience in Finance, Accounting, FP\&A, or a related financial function.
* Previous professional experience working with perishable products is strongly required, such as fresh produce, food distribution, grocery, food manufacturing, refrigerated products, or another high\-turn/perishable inventory environment.
* ***Prior experience with one of the Big 5 accounting firms is strongly preferred.***
* Strong FP\&A experience, including forecasting, budgeting, financial modeling, and variance analysis.
* Strong understanding of P\&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow, GAAP, and financial controls.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
* Experience working with ERP and financial reporting systems.
* Ability to take complex financial information and turn it into clear, actionable recommendations for senior leadership.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, organizational, and communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, operational environment with changing priorities.

The underlying job description also identifies experience in manufacturing, distribution, or food service as particularly relevant and calls for advanced Excel, financial modeling, ERP/reporting\-system experience, and strong analytical capabilities.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* CPA, CMA, and/or MBA.
* Experience in fresh produce, food distribution, grocery, food manufacturing, or refrigerated/perishable goods.
* Experience supporting distribution centers, warehouse operations, supply chain, or food\-service operations.
* Experience with inventory costing and margin analysis in a high\-volume environment.
* Bilingual English/Spanish is a plus.
* Demonstrated experience improving or automating financial reporting processes.

**Schedule \& Work Environment**

This is a hybrid position based in Los Angeles, California. The regular schedule is Monday through Friday, beginning at 7:00 AM.

The position requires four days per week onsite and allows one remote workday per week. Because this role partners closely with Operations and company leadership, candidates should be comfortable working onsite in an active food distribution environment.

**USC Marshall School of Business**

The University of Southern California (USC), founded in 1880, is located in the heart of downtown L.A. and is the largest private employer in the City of Los Angeles. jobs.title: Senior Financial Analyst
jobs.description:
**Scopely** is seeking a **Senior Finance Analyst** to join the team behind **MONOPOLY GO!** This role will be located in Culver City, CA on a hybrid basis.



In this role, you will own the game's recurring operational finance activities while building the tools and automation that make our work faster, more accurate, and more scalable. MONOPOLY GO! is a global phenomenon and the biggest mobile game launch in history, captivating millions of players worldwide.



You will lead operating expense month\-end close, accruals, headcount tracking, purchase orders, Workday approvals, and T\&E visibility. This is a build\-oriented role with a clear mandate to improve how the work gets done—not simply execute existing processes. We are looking for someone who can identify opportunities to apply AI and automation thoughtfully and effectively.



Over time, this role will help advance an AI\-native approach to FP\&A, connecting close, planning, reporting, and approvals so routine work can run more efficiently and the team can focus on higher\-value judgment. This is a greenfield opportunity with significant autonomy and a dedicated budget for tools and experimentation.



You will also serve as the primary Finance business partner to our Engineering organization, acting as its main point of contact for spending, headcount, and planning. You will work closely with Finance Managers, the VP of Finance for MONOPOLY GO!, and cross\-functional partners across the business, with strong senior\-level support as you ramp into the role.


### **Why this role stands out**


* **A build mandate.** You own the FP\&A automation stack — greenfield, with autonomy and a tool budget. A real part of the job is making the work better, not only keeping it running.
* **Scale and visibility.** MONOPOLY GO! is a large, fast\-growing business. Your work informs game leadership directly, with regular exposure to the VP of Finance.
* **Room to grow.** A path into complex modeling, financial storytelling, and broader scope across Scopely's portfolio, with mentorship to get there.
* **A strong team.** You'll join a high\-caliber group with backgrounds across high\-growth tech, consulting, banking, and private equity.

### **What you'll do**



The split is honest: expect the operational cadence to be a meaningful part of your week, and the build work to grow as you automate more of it.


* **Run the OpEx close cadence.** Month\-end close, accruals, reclasses, and headcount reconciliation, plus high\-volume PO/Workday approvals and T\&E — accurately, on time, and independently before long.
* **Build the automation.** Replace manual reporting with automated workflows and dashboards, and apply AI where it genuinely helps across close, planning, reporting, and approvals.
* **Partner with Engineering.** Act as the finance business partner to the MONOPOLY GO! Engineering organization — helping them understand and plan their spend and headcount — and work with People \& Talent, Business Operations, Customer Support, and QA to gather budget inputs and explain OpEx variances clearly.
* **Think in systems.** Connect steps across finance so the process gets simpler over time, with sensible checks where judgment matters.
* **Keep the models trustworthy.** Maintain revenue/cost and workforce\-planning models so leadership sees current, reconciled, defensible numbers.

### **What we're looking for**


* **An automation habit** — you've automated manual reporting or finance processes, and you're interested in applying AI to real work. Experience with BigQuery, SQL, Python, or AI tools is a big plus
* **Operational reliability** — a track record of dependable, detail\-accurate delivery on recurring, high\-volume work
* **Clear communication** — you can explain numbers and variances to non\-finance partners
* **Located in, or willing to relocate to, the Los Angeles metro,** working on\-site/hybrid
* **Ownership and integrity** — you do well in a fast\-paced, ambiguous environment, and are always looking for ways to add value
* **Strong Excel and financial modeling** — you build and maintain revenue/cost models and handle large datasets without hand\-holding
* **Hands\-on FP\&A foundation** — you've done planning, forecasting, variance analysis, and a real close/reporting cadence, and can hit the ground running
* **2–5 years** of finance/analytical experience, ideally in FP\&A or finance at a brand\-name technology or high\-growth company

### **How you work**


* You form your own point of view and make the case for it — and you let it go gracefully when someone has the better argument.
* You lead with questions. You learn why something is the way it is before you start rewiring it.
* You get to great by iterating. You put a solid version out early, invite feedback, and keep sharpening it.
* When something falls between the cracks, you assume it's yours. You close the loop instead of flagging it and moving on.
* When you hit the same manual task twice, your instinct is to automate it — not grind through it a third time.

### **Nice to have**


* **An undergraduate degree in engineering** (computer, mechanical, electrical, industrial, aerospace, etc.) — a real plus for this role.
* **Something you've built** — an automation or tool you can walk us through.
* Experience with financial systems such as Oracle and Workday / Workday Adaptive Planning.
* Data platforms — Big Query, etc.
* A genuine interest in games, consumer products, or technology\-driven businesses.

  



Please ensure that the résumé/CV you attach is written in English.

  

### **About Scopely**



Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world's most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all\-time "MONOPOLY GO!" and "Pokémon GO," along with "Stumble Guys," "Star Trek™ Fleet Command," "MARVEL Strike Force," "WWE Champions," the Scrabble® franchise, "Yahtzee® With Buddies,"

Under the direction of the Director Business Administration (DBA), serve as the Senior Financial Manager for Center X. Center X is a large, complex educational research and professional development center for educators in the School of Education and Information Studies (Ed\&IS.) Responsible for supporting financial management of the Center to oversee the budget and financial activities of 19900\-type, endowment, gift, sales and service (S\&S), federal, state, and private contract/grant funding sources with an average total annual expenditure of $23 million consisting of over 100 accounts. The Senior Financial Manager is independently responsible for providing advanced financial analysis, compliance monitoring, and accounting of the Center's federal, state, and private contract/grant funding sources in addition to 19900\-type funding. In collaboration with the DBA, the incumbent will lead the preparation and submission for new or renewal of extramurally funded research proposals and budgets. They will interface on critical contract and grant issues with the Ed\&IS fund manager, Office of Contract \& Grant Administration (OCGA), Extramural Fund Management, and corresponding granting agencies. Incumbent will review S\&S proposals, serve as liaison with UCLA Insurance and Risk Management (IRM), prepare contracts, submit invoices, track payments, and prepare OH transfer for campus. This position is responsible for preparing monthly financial management reports that provide clear, concise, and accurate financial data, as well as overseeing the reconciliation of expenditures against budgets for project directors, Center X leadership, and other key personnel. Incumbent will assist with long range financial planning and make recommendations based on historical data and future projections.  

**Salary \& Compensation**
  

  

\*UCLA provides a full pay range. Actual salary offers consider factors, including budget, prior experience, skills, knowledge, abilities, education, licensure and certifications, and other business considerations. Salary offers at the top of the range are not common. Visit UC Benefit package to discover benefits that start on day one, and UC Total Compensation Estimator to calculate the total compensation value with benefits.
  

**Qualifications**  

  

* 3\-5 Years Accounting or related financial experience (Required)

**Duties**
----------


The United States Space Force (USSF) at Los Angeles AFB, El Segundo, CA is searching for a Financial Analyst to support SYD 80 (NH\-0501\-03, GS 12/13 equivalent).  

  

Description:  

Are you ready to fuel the future of national security space launch? Space Force Portfolio Acquisition Executive (SFPAE) for Space Access (SFPAE/SA) is a premier organization within the Space Systems Command (SSC). SFPAE/SA secures reliable, responsive launch services for the National Security Space Launch (NSSL) program, operates and sustains the nation's busiest spaceports, and is rapidly pioneering next\-generation on\-orbit servicing and satellite refueling. Based in the heart of the aerospace industry in El Segundo, CA, this is not just a job tracking spreadsheets\-it is a mission\-critical role where your financial acumen directly translates into rockets lifting off, cutting\-edge satellites deploying, and next\-generation space logistics technologies becoming reality.  

  

In this high\-impact position, you will manage, execute, and safeguard multi\-million and billion\-dollar portfolios encompassing RDT\&E, Procurement, and O\&M funds. You will collaborate closely with military leaders, elite aerospace engineers, and industry partners to navigate complex acquisition landscapes, solve intricate financial challenges, and drive strategic budget decisions. If you are a proactive problem\-solver who thrives in a fast\-paced environment and wants to make a tangible impact on the nation's high\-visibility space programs, SFPAE/SA is where your career can truly launch.  

  

  

Ideal Candidate:  

The Financial Management Analyst will act as a critical financial advisor and business partner to program managers, engineers, and leadership within the Space Force Portfolio Acquisition Executive (SFPAE) for Space Access (SFPAE/SA). Operating in El Segundo, CA, this position manages, executes, and audits multi\-million and billion\-dollar budgets (including RDT\&E, Procurement, and O\&M funds) that directly enable launch service task orders, infrastructure modernization, and cutting\-edge space logistics acquisitions. The candidate should have the ability to translate complex financial data, shortfalls, and execution metrics into clear briefings to leadership. The candidate should be able to solve problems under shifting program deadlines, sudden budget drills, and unexpected funding adjustments typical in high\-visibility space acquisition initiatives.  

  

A bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, business administration, economics, or a closely related field that includes at least 24 semester hours in business\-related courses is required. Candidate should have at least 3\-5 years of federal financial management experience, preferably within a DoD or Department of the Air Force acquisition program. High proficiency in using CCaR (Comprehensive Cost and Requirement System) is critical for managing program requirements and tracking execution. Direct, hands\-on experience with core systems including DEAMS (Defense Enterprise Accounting and Management System) and FM Suite. Candidate should have a deep understanding of DoD colors of money (RDT\&E, Procurement, O\&M) and their respective lifespans and legal restrictions.
  

  

An ideal candidate must be prepared to handle the unique and complex financial workflows of the SFPAE/SA:  

* Budget Formulation \& Execution: Build, justify, and execute complex program budgets. Track commitments, obligations, and expenditures against OSW (Office of the Secretary of War) benchmarks
* Acquisition Decision Support: Provide financial analysis, cost\-benefit analyses, and risk assessments for high\-value contract actions, such as launch service task orders or space mobility research agreements.
* Reconciliations \& Systems Management: Navigate, reconcile, and extract data across defense financial systems to resolve complex transactions, ensure data integrity, and interface with higher headquarters and outside agencies
* Audit Readiness \& Internal Controls: Ensure complete compliance with the Department of War Financial Management Regulation (DoW FMR) and Financial Improvement and Audit Remediation (FIAR) standards. Keep all financial packages audit\-ready and traceable.

  
**Requirements**
----------------

* Must be a U.S. Citizen.
* Employee must be able to obtain and maintain a Secret clearance.
* Position will close in 5 business days or 75 applications (whichever comes first).
* Required to handle and safeguard sensitive and/or classified information in accordance with regulations to reduce potential compromise.
* PCS / Incentive not authorized.

Under direct supervision, this position is responsible for procuring materials, parts, components, and software in the United States based on requests from Mitsubishi Electric Corporation and its affiliated companies (“MELCO”). The position coordinates the export of these products, primarily to Japan, provides product and supplier information to MELCO and its affiliated companies, and supports purchasing and administrative activities through order processing, data management, and report preparation.
  

  

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**


* Request quotations from vendors upon receipt of RFQs (Requests for Quotation) from MELCO. Prepare and submit MEUS quotations to customers and follow up until Purchase Order Requests (O/Rs) are issued.
* Review pricing and conduct routine negotiations with vendors, as necessary, before MELCO issues an O/R.
* Generate and issue MEUS purchase orders to vendors upon receipt of customer O/Rs from MELCO.
* Monitor supplier performance, product quality, and delivery schedules to ensure requirements are met.
* Classify deliverables and/or technical data identified in MEUS purchase orders in accordance with the MEUS Export Compliance Program (ECP) prior to export.
* Under direct supervision, assist in preparing export license applications to the U.S. Department of State (DOS) or the U.S. Department of Commerce (DOC), in coordination with the Legal Department and MEUS Export Control Administrator (ECA). Responsibilities include collecting required information from customers and coordinating the application process after issuance of the MEUS purchase order and prior to export.

After all export compliance requirements have been satisfied, generate MEUS invoices, obtain required approvals, and authorize shipment under MEUS's power of attorney.

* Research and identify new suppliers and products throughout North and South America and introduce potential opportunities to MELCO.

You’ll get customers excited about shopping and selling second\-hand fashion, whether it’s their first time or their 1000th!  

  

**Minimum Requirements:**
* Must be able to work a minimum of 12 hours per week.
* 6\+ months of retail experience.
* Have a good eye for fashion and current trends.
* Must be authorized to work in the United States.

When you join Crossroads, you are joining the sustainable fashion movement and reshaping fashion culture. And you aren’t just impacting the planet’s future\- you are impacting your own.
* We have clear paths for promotion and several routes you can take as you embark on your second\-hand retail journey.
* You’ll learn how to run a second\-hand business– you’ll embody an entrepreneurial spirit\- learning everything from buying, merchandising and inventory practices to gaining and maintaining the trust of a customer base who has been devoted since day one.

**You are:**
* **A Team Player**. You are as enthusiastic about the success of others as you are about your own success.
* **Authentic**. You are your unique self!
* **Fashion\-focused.** You eat, breathe, and sleep style. Fashion is life.
* **Adaptable**. You feel comfortable adjusting to changing circumstances and encourage your teammates to do the same. We problem\-solve together!
* **People**\-**first**. You are energized by people. You radiate kindness and positivity! You understand your impact and are someone who uplifts others.

**You will:**
* **Engage**. You get to meet new people, every day! Greet each customer with a smile and welcome them to our store. Create a welcoming, fun, and inclusive environment to shop and work in.
* **Ask and Educate**. You will teach our customers how we work and get them excited about selling their clothes to us!
* **Have Integrity**. You will act with integrity in words and actions\- do the right thing and do it right, even when it’s difficult.
* **Be Compassionate**. You will embody our core values of service, inclusion, and education. It’s important that we connect with all customers and try our best to help them.
* **Be Reliable**. You will show up to work on time and ready to go!
* **Be Flexible**. You understand that needs change and evolve throughout the day\- you know how to support your team and customer as needed.
* **Enjoy Organizing.** Cleaning, organizing, and merchandising are all parts of the job and help create the best possible shopping and working environment.

**Perks:**

  

**Health \+ Wellbeing**
**We will:**
* **Support your wellbeing**. We care about our employees holistically and offer sick paid time off.
* **Prioritize wellness for all.** We offer medical, dental, and vision insurance for ALL employees who work at least 20 hours a week!

**Work/Life Harmony**
**We will:**
* **Give you incentives when you work during the holidays.** We pay time and a half on select holidays throughout the year, and we are closed on Thanksgiving and Christmas.
* **Encourage work/life balance.** We offer flexible scheduling so that you can meet work \& life needs!

**Financial Health**
**We will:**
* **Contribute to your 401(k)**. Free money? We’ll match up to 4% of your contribution as soon as you enroll \& an additional discretionary 2% at year\-end! We offer both a Roth and traditional 401(k).
* **Offer** a generousdiscount on all merchandise including luxury consignment pieces\- shop where you work!
* **Be Transparent.** We have clear pay ranges and always advertise pay for positions. We believe in pay equity.
* **Offer Earned Wage Access.** Need money before payday? You’ll be able to access pay as you earn it through our partner app ZayZoon
* **Contribute** **to Commuter Benefits**. Take public transit? We’ll contribute and match a portion of your commuter account monthly.

**Growth \+ Development**
**We will:**
* **Let you take the lead.** We offer clear paths for growth and ongoing professional development that are straightforward and attainable.
* **Celebrate with you**. We’ll provide you with many opportunities to bond with your team as you celebrate successes together.
* **Equip you with the tools to be successful**. As you onboard \& throughout your career, our training programs will set you up to win.

**About Crossroads**
One of the first companies to pioneer secondhand clothing as an alternative to traditional retail, Crossroads Trading has been buying, selling, and consigning name brand and designer clothing in a friendly, fun, and fashionable atmosphere since 1991\.  


Since opening the doors of its first location in the heart of San Francisco’s Fillmore District, Crossroads has expanded over time to 38 retail locations spanning Northern and Southern California, Chicago, Seattle, Portland, Denver, New York, and Houston. And in recent years, we have added Sell\-By\-Mail and Concierge programs to provide convenient new ways for fashionable and eco\-conscious customers to sell their gently used clothing.  

Crossroads has been featured in Harper’s Bazaar, Teen Vogue, and LA Mag, and is widely recognized as an industry leader in the ‘resale revolution.’
  

**If you like sustainability, fashion, and working in a fun, positive environment, you’ll enjoy a career with us!**

Founded in 1999, the company specializes in sourcing and supplying electronic, electrical, and electromechanical components, including hard\-to\-find and obsolete parts, while maintaining a strong focus on quality, traceability, and counterfeit\-part prevention. Area51 Electronics supports customers through component sourcing, inventory management, kitting, supply\-chain services, and quality assurance, providing employees with the opportunity to work in a fast\-paced environment supporting critical technology and manufacturing programs.

 **Job Summary:**


**THIS POSITION IS ONSITE (IRVINE)**

 1\. No Disapproved Independent Distributors

 N. Expedite and track pending purchase orders with vendors to ensure on\-time delivery.



 O. Archive completed purchase orders on our network drive.

3\. Adhere to company’s Quality Management System (QMS) and comply to all purchasing related policies, procedures, and forms.



4\. Learn the relationship between the Purchasing Department and other departments.



5\. Initiate and establish relationships with the company’s vendors.



6\. Start the initial evaluations and re\-evaluations with authorized distributors, authorized resellers, and manufacturers.



7\. Attend monthly purchasing and company meetings.



8\. Utilize Area51 Electronics’ proprietary software program and electronic properties (i.e. computer, printer, etc.) for all job functions.



9\. Contribute to and provide QMS and purchasing process improvements and suggestions.

jobs.title: Senior Buyer/Planner
jobs.description:
**POSITION SUMMARY****:**


Reporting to the Executive Director of Manufacturing \& Supply Chain, the Senior Buyer/Planner is responsible for coordinating procurement and material planning activities to ensure the timely availability of raw materials, components, packaging materials, consumables, and other supplies required to support GMP drug product manufacturing operations. This position serves as a key liaison between Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Quality, Warehouse, Finance, Engineering, and Client Services to proactively identify and resolve material and supply risks.


The Senior Buyer/Planner develops and maintains material requirements and purchasing plans based on production schedules, inventory levels, lead times, client requirements, and forecasted demand. The position is expected to maintain strong supplier relationships, monitor supplier performance, manage purchase orders, and ensure materials are available in accordance with approved specifications, quality requirements, and production timelines.


The ideal candidate has strong knowledge of purchasing, production planning, inventory management, and GMP requirements and is comfortable working in a fast\-paced CDMO environment where priorities and production requirements may change frequently.

**PRINCIPAL DUTIES****:**

* Create and maintain an integrated planning process to align PLI Leadership/ Business Development and Supply Chain with a demand plan, while clearly articulating the assumptions, risks, and opportunities to the plan.
* Identify and select suppliers, negotiate contracts, and ensure timely and cost\-effective procurement of raw materials, components, and other necessary supplies.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders, including Micro/Analytical, Manufacturing, and Quality Assurance, to provide purchasing support and ensure alignment on vendor selection and performance
* Utilize supply management software and tools to develop and implement long\-term and short\-term supply chain strategies.
* Identify opportunities for process improvement within supply chain, implementing best practices and lean methodologies to enhance efficiency and reduce costs.
* Negotiate, or renegotiate, and manage contractual arrangements with suppliers, vendors and other representatives to incorporate best pricing.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including Manufacturing, Quality Assurance, and Project Management, to create accurate demand forecasts and production plans. Monitor delivery dates to ensure that goods arrive on time. In the event of problems, trace shipments and follow up on undelivered goods.
* Confer with staff, users, and vendors to discuss defective or unacceptable goods or services and determine corrective action.
* Manage material flow, inventory control and accuracy through monitoring and management of daily warehouse activities, cycle counts, expiration dating, production orders, and audits.
* Manage product storage and distribution department.
* In collaboration with Quality Assurance, contribute to vendor qualification and maintain vendor status and qualify all incoming materials.
* Research and evaluate suppliers based on price, quality, selection, service, support, availability, reliability, production and distribution capabilities, and the supplier’s reputation and history.
* Analyze sales records and inventory levels of current stock to develop strategic purchasing programs that facilitate employee access to supplies.
* Interview vendors to examine and learn about products, services and prices.
* Formulate policy and develop and implement new strategies and procedures for procurement.
* Manage and optimize supply chain and related manufacturing processes to improve efficiency, reduce waste, and ensure product quality including change management processes (Change controls. Deviations, CAPAs).
* Contribute to fostering a culture of accountability, safety, and continuous improvement.
* Develop and evaluate short\- and long\-range procurement plans as applicable.
* Perform other related duties and responsibilities as assigned.

**QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE:**

* 5\+ years’ experience in Supply Chain/Manufacturing or related support functions or any combination of those within the field of Life Sciences
* Experience in aseptic Manufacturing preferred
* Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, logistics, engineering, or life sciences
* Knowledge of MS Office Suite, ERP and MRP Systems
* Proven track record of planning/procurement and vendor management working at a CDMO

jobs.title: Senior Financial Analyst, Corporate Finance
jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI\-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.


Join us to put AI to work for people.

 **Job Description** **What you get to do in this role:**


This role sits at the center of ServiceNow's multi\-year planning process, connecting strategy, operating plans, financial performance, and investment decisions into a clear view of the company's long\-term outlook.

* Own ServiceNow's integrated long\-range financial model — revenue, margin, Opex, headcount, cash flow, and key SaaS metrics — and lead the annual long\-range planning process that ties it to the operating plan and quarterly forecasts
* Evaluate investment proposals, resource allocation, and operating tradeoffs through scenario and sensitivity analysis under consistent financial frameworks
* Turn broad strategic questions into executive\-ready analysis and recommendations with minimal direction, isolating the drivers that matter from large, multi\-source datasets
* Align planning assumptions, timelines, and methodologies with business unit and functional Finance teams, building cross\-functional agreement without formal authority
* Build KPI and driver\-based frameworks, monitor internal performance against external benchmarks, and improve planning through automation, standardization, and AI\-enabled workflows

  

**Qualifications** **To be successful in this role you have:**

* Experience integrating AI into work processes, decision\-making, or problem\-solving — including tools such as Claude and Microsoft Copilot to automate recurring workflows and build analyses, models, and reporting
* 5\+ years in FP\&A, strategic finance, investment banking, equity research, or management consulting, with strong modeling skills across integrated multi\-year models, driver\-based forecasts, and scenario analyses
* A solid grasp of financial statements, corporate finance, and SaaS business models and metrics
* A bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related field
* Ability to distill complex analysis into crisp, executive\-level messaging; advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills
* High ownership, intellectual curiosity, and attention to detail
* Hands\-on experience with Pigment, Anaplan, or comparable planning tools and with Power BI and/or Snowflake preferred


FD21

  

For positions in this location, we offer a base pay of $116,400 \- $192,100, plus equity (when applicable), variable/incentive compensation and benefits. Sales positions generally offer a competitive On Target Earnings (OTE) incentive compensation structure. Please note that the base pay shown is a guideline, and individual total compensation will vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, competencies, and work location. We also offer health plans, including flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) Plan with company match, ESPP, matching donations, a flexible time away plan and family leave programs.  

Compensation is based on the geographic location in which the role is located and is subject to change based on work location. **Additional Information** **Work Personas**

Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third\-party service.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements.

jobs.title: Financial Analyst, Compute Infrastructure Business
jobs.description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Sunnyvale, CA, USA; Chicago, IL, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Statistics, or another quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 4 years of experience in financial planning and analysis (FP\&A), consulting, or a related function.
* Experience executing full\-cycle FP\&A functions including budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and modeling within a multinational company setting.
* Experience with SQL.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience in business strategy and cloud strategy.
* Experience with communication strategy and presenting financial insights.
* Knowledge of the Cloud and Software industry, including different roles and incentives.

**About the job**
-----------------


Financial Analysts ensure that Google makes sound financial decisions. As a Financial Analyst, your work, whether it's modeling business scenarios or tracking performance metrics, is used by our leaders to make company decisions. Working on multiple projects at a time, you are focused on the details while finding creative ways to take on big picture issues.  

  

As someone who knows the workings of the core Finance team inside and out, you'll lead individual projects to transform planning, tracking and control processes. You'll provide executive level management with insightful recommendations, planning and reporting support.



Cloud is a priority for Google. We develop groundbreaking solutions, including Google Cloud Platform and Workspace, to enable our clients’ digital transformation. Our department ensures that Capacity and Technical Infrastructure organizations make sound commercial choices for investments in the enterprise. We are an important advisor to division leaders, providing analytical and strategic guidance.  

  

In this role within the Planning and Analysis (FP\&A) group, you will focus on Compute Infrastructure, specifically steering the core Compute Engine suite. You will guide critical operational choices, such as feature sequencing and rate calibration, while delivering bottom\-line visibility through profitability assessments. You will collaborate with cross\-functional groups to support commercial rollouts, new launches, and balanced capital deployment.


The name Google came from "googol," a mathematical term for the number 1 followed by 100 zeros. And nobody at Google loves big numbers like the Finance team when providing in depth analysis on all manner of strategic decisions across Google products. From developing forward\-thinking analysis to generating management reports to scaling our automated financial processes, the Finance organization is an important partner and advisor to the business.Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $116000 \- $166000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Manage the Profit and Loss (P\&L) for the Google Compute Engine product portfolio, providing in\-depth analysis to optimize financial performance.

jobs.description:
The Human Services Agency (HSA) of County of San Mateo is seeking qualified **Child Welfare Program Analyst (Human Services Analyst II)** to join the Children and Family Services (C\&FS) Branch. The CWPA will report to the Children and Family Services Administrative and Program Support Services Manager and will support **Child Welfare System Strategies and Contracted Services**.


The Child Welfare Program Analyst (CWPA) provides analytical, administrative, and project support for programs within Children and Family Services. This position requires independent judgment, strong organizational and analytical skills, and ideally a general knowledge of child welfare programs and practices. The CWPA may be assigned lead responsibility for projects and initiatives and will work closely with program managers, internal teams, community partners, and other stakeholders.


**CWS\-CARES Go\-Live:** A key responsibility of this position will be serving as the lead analyst as part of the Organizational Change Management Team for **CWS\-CARES**, the new child welfare Statewide case management system, scheduled to go\-live December 7, 2026\. Responsibilities will include developing and maintaining business process maps and implementation resources; providing on\-site and over\-the\-shoulder support during and after go\-live; maintaining SharePoint content and resource repositories; preparing communications, reports, and other project materials; and providing ongoing implementation support while adapting to evolving project needs, priorities, and timelines.


**Program Support and Contracted Services:** In addition to supporting CWS\-CARES implementation, the CWPA will work with Program Managers to develop and maintain a variety of documents, including, but not limited to, scopes of work, request for proposals, written reports, data reports, performance metrics, and County forms. The CWPA will receive and process invoices and help facilitate related signature and tracking processes.


Additional responsibilities may include conducting research and providing information to support management recommendations; supporting the integration of key initiatives and C\&FS priorities; communicating with community organizations regarding program requirements; working closely with community\-based service providers to support program compliance and provide technical assistance; developing service agreements; reviewing and interpreting State guidance and policies; and performing other duties as assigned.


The ideal candidate is a collaborative, organized, proactive, and adaptable professional who enjoys working as part of a team and can effectively navigate a fast\-paced and evolving environment. The successful candidate will be comfortable taking initiative, identifying what needs to be done, and stepping in to support the team without always being asked.


The **ideal candidate** will demonstrate:


* **Analytical and problem\-solving skills:** Ability to analyze information, identify issues, develop practical solutions, and make sound recommendations.
* **Project management and organization:** Ability to coordinate projects, manage competing priorities and deadlines, and follow through on assignments.
* **Communication:** Ability to communicate clearly and professionally and prepare concise, accurate written materials.
* **Initiative and adaptability:** Takes ownership, anticipates needs, and adjusts effectively to changing priorities and project needs.
* **Collaboration:** Works effectively with staff, managers, community partners, service providers, and other stakeholders.
* **Program and process knowledge:** Experience supporting the development, implementation, and improvement of programs and processes; general knowledge of child welfare or social service programs and practices is desirable.
**Duties may include, but are not limited to, the following:**


* Develop grants and contracts with the State and other funding sources, including the negotiation of specific items in the agreement and budget preparation.
* Draft requests for proposals, evaluate proposals and negotiate contracts.
* Provide technical programmatic and fiscal assistance to staff and subcontractors, including the development of policies and procedures and the training of staff.
* Monitor and evaluate the performance of subcontractors, including budget analysis and field monitoring, to ensure conformance with performance goals and fiscal requirements.
* Develop and implement marketing and funding strategies and policies and procedures for assigned programs; develop and monitor budgets.
* Represent assigned programs and the Agency at various meetings and conferences and serve as the liaison with the state and other organizations.
* Analyze legislation and develop policy and procedures for implementation by staff and subcontractors.
* Provide work direction to support staff.

* Write reports and grant proposals and make presentations to boards, committees and other groups.
* Coordinate and conduct special events and projects.
* Develop and maintain computer files and generate reports.
* Perform related duties as assigned.

**Note: This is a limited\-term, at\-will assignment. Limited term employees are assigned to assignments not to exceed three years. ----------------


The Park District has **two** **(2\) vacancies** located at the Park District’s Administrative Office in Oakland, CA. One vacancy is in the Grants Department, and one vacancy is in the Risk Management Department. The hiring pools established from this recruitment will be used to fill the current vacancies and additional vacancies that may occur during the one\-year life of the hiring pools.


**Grants — Administrative Analyst II**


The East Bay Regional Park District is currently recruiting for an **Administrative Analyst II** to support the District’s Grants Department, with administration and oversight of grant\-funded programs and projects that support natural resources, public access, and enjoyment of Park District lands. This role will support a diverse portfolio of funding programs, including local grantmaking, FEMA Public Assistance, and funding from the Regional Parks Foundation, while coordinating closely with internal departments and external funding agencies. The Administrative Analyst II will analyze grant requirements and funding opportunities, assist with grant budgets and funding strategies, coordinate reimbursement requests and amendments, monitor compliance and deadlines, and maintain complete and well\-organized grant records. The position will also prepare the documentation required for the annual Single Audit, as well as prepare reports, data, and presentations for staff and the Board of Directors, support grant closeout and federal reporting requirements, and help ensure successful delivery and documentation of grant\-funded work. The position offers an opportunity to work across a variety of funding programs and multidisciplinary projects while building relationships with funders, project partners, District staff, and leadership in support of the District’s mission.

**WAGE RANGE: $18\.95\-$21\.95 PER HOUR**  

  

**The Resale Revolution Starts With You!**
As a Crossroads Buyer, you will bring our brand promise to life: to offer a fun, fashion\-centered, and affordable shopping experience to our communities. You’ll hand select items to sell in our stores and provide a high\-level of customer service. You’ll get customers excited about shopping and selling second\-hand fashion, whether it’s their first time or their 1000th!  

  

**Minimum Requirements:**
* Must be able to work a minimum of 12 hours per week.
* 6\+ months of retail experience.
* Have a good eye for fashion and current trends.
* Must be authorized to work in the United States.

When you join Crossroads, you are joining the sustainable fashion movement and reshaping fashion culture. And you aren’t just impacting the planet’s future\- you are impacting your own.
* We have clear paths for promotion and several routes you can take as you embark on your second\-hand retail journey.
* You’ll learn how to run a second\-hand business– you’ll embody an entrepreneurial spirit\- learning everything from buying, merchandising and inventory practices to gaining and maintaining the trust of a customer base who has been devoted since day one.

**You are:**
* **A Team Player**. You are as enthusiastic about the success of others as you are about your own success.
* **Authentic**. You are your unique self!
* **Fashion\-focused.** You eat, breathe, and sleep style. Fashion is life.
* **Adaptable**. You feel comfortable adjusting to changing circumstances and encourage your teammates to do the same. We problem\-solve together!
* **People**\-**first**. You are energized by people. You radiate kindness and positivity! You understand your impact and are someone who uplifts others.

**You will:**
* **Engage**. You get to meet new people, every day! Greet each customer with a smile and welcome them to our store. Create a welcoming, fun, and inclusive environment to shop and work in.
* **Ask and Educate**. You will teach our customers how we work and get them excited about selling their clothes to us!
* **Have Integrity**. You will act with integrity in words and actions\- do the right thing and do it right, even when it’s difficult.
* **Be Compassionate**. You will embody our core values of service, inclusion, and education. It’s important that we connect with all customers and try our best to help them.
* **Be Reliable**. You will show up to work on time and ready to go!
* **Be Flexible**. You understand that needs change and evolve throughout the day\- you know how to support your team and customer as needed.
* **Enjoy Organizing.** Cleaning, organizing, and merchandising are all parts of the job and help create the best possible shopping and working environment.

**Perks:**

  

**Health \+ Wellbeing**
**We will:**
* **Support your wellbeing**. We care about our employees holistically and offer sick paid time off.
* **Prioritize wellness for all.** We offer medical, dental, and vision insurance for ALL employees who work at least 20 hours a week!

**Work/Life Harmony**
**We will:**
* **Give you incentives when you work during the holidays.** We pay time and a half on select holidays throughout the year, and we are closed on Thanksgiving and Christmas.
* **Encourage work/life balance.** We offer flexible scheduling so that you can meet work \& life needs!

**Financial Health**
**We will:**
* **Contribute to your 401(k)**. Free money? We’ll match up to 4% of your contribution as soon as you enroll \& an additional discretionary 2% at year\-end! We offer both a Roth and traditional 401(k).
* **Offer** a generousdiscount on all merchandise including luxury consignment pieces\- shop where you work!
* **Be Transparent.** We have clear pay ranges and always advertise pay for positions. We believe in pay equity.
* **Offer Earned Wage Access.** Need money before payday? You’ll be able to access pay as you earn it through our partner app ZayZoon
* **Contribute** **to Commuter Benefits**. Take public transit? We’ll contribute and match a portion of your commuter account monthly.

**Growth \+ Development**
**We will:**
* **Let you take the lead.** We offer clear paths for growth and ongoing professional development that are straightforward and attainable.
* **Celebrate with you**. We’ll provide you with many opportunities to bond with your team as you celebrate successes together.
* **Equip you with the tools to be successful**. As you onboard \& throughout your career, our training programs will set you up to win.

**About Crossroads**
One of the first companies to pioneer secondhand clothing as an alternative to traditional retail, Crossroads Trading has been buying, selling, and consigning name brand and designer clothing in a friendly, fun, and fashionable atmosphere since 1991\.  


Since opening the doors of its first location in the heart of San Francisco’s Fillmore District, Crossroads has expanded over time to 38 retail locations spanning Northern and Southern California, Chicago, Seattle, Portland, Denver, New York, and Houston. And in recent years, we have added Sell\-By\-Mail and Concierge programs to provide convenient new ways for fashionable and eco\-conscious customers to sell their gently used clothing.  

Crossroads has been featured in Harper’s Bazaar, Teen Vogue, and LA Mag, and is widely recognized as an industry leader in the ‘resale revolution.’
  

**If you like sustainability, fashion, and working in a fun, positive environment, you’ll enjoy a career with us!**

Comfrt is seeking a Senior Financial Analyst to support financial planning, forecasting, reporting, and analysis across our rapidly growing business. This role is ideal for a highly analytical, hands\-on finance professional with strong FP\&A; capabilities and strong accounting fundamentals.



Reporting to the Director of FP\&A;, this individual will be responsible for the day\-to\-day execution of key FP\&A; activities, including financial reporting, forecast preparation, expense tracking, and variance analysis. The Senior Financial Analyst will work closely with Accounting and cross\-functional partners to ensure financial information is accurate and complete, investigate performance drivers, and surface meaningful insights for review.  

  

**Responsibilities:**

  

* Prepare monthly forecasts, annual budget schedules, and supporting financial analyses.
* Prepare monthly financial reporting and analyze results against forecast, budget, and prior year.
* Perform detailed variance analysis, investigate underlying drivers, and provide clear explanations of significant variances, trends, risks, and opportunities for review.
* Maintain financial models, reporting schedules, and supporting analyses.
* Review general ledger activity, understand the accounting behind financial results, and partner with Accounting to investigate discrepancies and ensure accurate reporting.
* Maintain department\-level expense tracking and forecasts, including gathering inputs from cross\-functional partners.
* Prepare P\&L;, KPI, and management reporting with clear commentary on key business drivers.
* Perform ad hoc financial analysis and scenario modeling to support business needs.
* Identify opportunities to improve the accuracy and efficiency of FP\&A; reporting and processes.


**Qualifications:**


* 4\+ years of experience in FP\&A;, corporate finance, accounting, or a combination of finance and accounting roles.
* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related field.
* Strong accounting fundamentals, including a thorough understanding of financial statements, general ledger activity, accruals, account classifications, and the monthly close process.
* Experience with budgeting, forecasting, financial modeling, and variance analysis.
* Advanced Excel and/or Google Sheets skills, including the ability to work efficiently with large and detailed datasets.
* Experience with ERP/accounting systems and business intelligence tools; QuickBooks Online, NetSuite, Looker, Tableau, or similar platforms is a plus.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to clearly summarize financial findings and key takeaways.
* Experience in ecommerce, retail, consumer products, or a high\-growth DTC environment is a plus.
* Detail\-oriented and proactive, with the ability to independently complete analyses, identify when something doesn't look right, and dig into the details to understand why.
* Analytical and curious, with a desire to understand the story behind the numbers.
* Comfortable working with detailed financial data and following an issue through to resolution.
* Organized and dependable, with the ability to manage recurring deliverables and multiple priorities.
* Collaborative and comfortable working across Finance, Accounting, and other business functions.
* Adaptable and resourceful, with the ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced environment where processes continue to evolve.


**Why Join Comfrt?**


* Be part of a purpose\-driven company that's shaping the future of comfort and mental wellness.
* Work in a supportive, creative environment where your ideas and growth are valued.
* Enjoy Comfrt benefits such as generous paid time off, company\-covered health insurance, 5% 401k match, and discounts on all Comfrt products!
* Join a passionate team making an impact on exciting projects, all while enjoying the flexibility and collaborative support of a fully remote environment.


*Comfort is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.*

The incumbent collaborates extensively with departments, schools, the Dean's Office, and institutional partners, including OPAM, CFS, and other administrative units, to resolve financial, operational, and compliance\-related issues while ensuring adherence to federal regulations, sponsor requirements, and OHSU policies and procedures. Additional responsibilities include participation in team meetings, development and maintenance of departmental policies and procedures, training and advising colleagues on financial and grant administration matters and contributing to special projects and strategic initiatives as assigned by the Senior Director, OHSU leadership, and faculty. Preferred Qualifications:
