jobs.description:
*Come join our team! Reveille provides a full benefits package include medical/dental/vision, FSA, paid time off, commuting reimbursement, 401K / matching, Wellness subsidies, LTD/STD/AD\&D insurance, and salary \+ incentive (bonus) compensation. We're a team of strategically\-minded consultants who focus on prioritizing a work\-life balance.*

  

Reveille Group is a strategic advisory consulting firm with offices in Washington, DC. We are focused on providing our diverse clients with innovative solutions including technical analysis and development. We are looking to bring on an integral team member to provide support for an existing project. You will function as a Senior Program and Management Analyst for a federal agency. Please note this is a remote position, and you must be in the contiguous United States available to travel to DC and other locations on occasion/as needed.


**Role Description**  

The Senior Program and Management Analyst will provide strategic, analytical, and operational support to the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services Procurement Management Review and Special Review program. The analyst will help sustain and improve a mature, repeatable, risk\-informed oversight framework that evaluates acquisition practices, internal controls, compliance, program performance, corrective actions, and enterprise improvement opportunities.


This role combines senior program analysis with practical acquisition knowledge. The analyst will coordinate reviews, structure management information, analyze evidence and trends, draft decision\-ready products, maintain performance and corrective\-action tools, support modernization, and transfer knowledge to Government personnel. Government reviewers and authorized officials retain responsibility for substantive acquisition, compliance, policy, and enforcement determinations.


**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Support planning, execution, reporting, and follow\-up for Procurement Management Reviews and Special Reviews, including concurrent reviews with competing schedules, limited reviewer availability, and shifting leadership priorities.

  

* Develop and maintain integrated review schedules, milestones, resource plans, workload forecasts, dependencies, decision points, risks, issues, action items, and recovery plans across the PMR portfolio.


* Translate Government\-defined review objectives, risk inputs, internal\-control considerations, and acquisition priorities into organized planning packages, schedules, review tools, and management controls for Government approval.


* Coordinate Government reviewers, reviewed organizations, leadership, acquisition stakeholders, and contractor personnel throughout planning, fieldwork, reporting, corrective\-action monitoring, and closeout.


* Prepare stakeholder maps, communication protocols, kickoff materials, agendas, data calls, status briefings, meeting records, executive summaries, decision papers, and escalation packages.


* Capture and organize Government reviewer input and maintain traceability among review criteria, requested evidence, source documents, reviewer observations, Government conclusions, findings, recommendations, corrective actions, and closure evidence.


* Draft and edit review products, including planning documents, observations, findings, root\-cause narratives, risk statements, recommendations, draft and final PMR reports, leadership briefings, and remediation summaries for Government review.


* Apply federal acquisition knowledge to help identify potential regulatory, policy, internal\-control, file\-documentation, competition, planning, administration, and post\-award issues for disposition by Government reviewers.


* Support risk\-based prioritization of review focus areas and clearly document risk exposure, internal\-control implications, mitigation considerations, assumptions, limitations, and matters requiring Government judgment.


* Maintain a centralized corrective\-action record containing finding references, responsible organizations, action owners, due dates, status, supporting evidence, residual risk, dependencies, decisions, and closure documentation.


* Analyze overdue actions, weak closure evidence, repeat findings, ineffective corrective actions, recurring deficiencies, systemic acquisition risks, and cross\-organization trends; develop actionable insights for leadership consideration.


* Develop and maintain performance measures, targets, definitions, calculations, data sources, reporting frequencies, baselines, thresholds, and evidence for the Performance Objective Outcome Matrix and related program\-health reporting.


* Update the Outcome Matrix as a living management tool, including actual results, current status, risks, Government dependencies, recovery actions, owners, due dates, and decisions needed; support monthly and event\-driven reviews.


* Use Government\-approved tools to produce status views, dashboards, indicators, aging analyses, trend summaries, recurring\-theme analyses, workload forecasts, and concise executive insights.


* Support practical modernization of PMR workflows, including standardized intake, structured data collection, validation, aggregation, status tracking, dashboarding, automation, and appropriate human\-governed use of emerging technologies.


* Define and execute data\-quality, access\-control, validation, version\-control, and human\-review procedures so automation improves efficiency without replacing Government reviewer judgment.


* Perform documented quality reviews of contractor\-generated schedules, trackers, findings, reports, briefings, analytical products, and executive materials for accuracy, consistency, evidence support, methodology conformance, and usability.


* Lead lessons\-learned activities and maintain approved methodologies, standard operating procedures, templates, job aids, reviewer onboarding materials, training resources, change logs, and knowledge repositories.

jobs.title: Sr. Financial Analyst
jobs.description:
Who We Are:

We are women\-owned and operated, with nearly 50 years of expertise as a leading environmental solutions provider, focused on infection prevention for complex facilities. As a local, privately held company, we are agile and can maneuver quickly to support the needs of our people and clients.  

Our goal is to become a trusted partner, not outsourced vendor.  

One of our greatest strengths is our Culture of Caring. From our CEO to the front\-line staff, Servicon embodies our vision of creating healthy environments for people to thrive. This results in greater client satisfaction and healthier outcomes. Meticulous adherence to infection prevention standards interwoven with compassionate service delivery is the key to success.  

Servicon focuses on three essential elements for establishing a Culture of Caring and Excellence: People, Programs, and Performance. These components represent our strong value alignment, positively impacting patient care, infection prevention, and throughput.
The Role:
**Lo****ve turning numbers into meaningful business decisions? This opportunity is for you.**  

We’re looking for a **Senior Financial Analyst** who can go beyond the spreadsheets—someone who wants to understand the *why* behind the numbers, uncover the drivers of performance, and turn financial and operational data into insights that move the business forward.  

In this hybrid role, you’ll partner closely with operational leaders to identify opportunities, improve margins and cash flow, and help shape stronger financial performance. If you’re analytical, curious, hands\-on, and energized by connecting the dots between data, operations, and strategy, we’d love to hear from you. **Come help us turn insights into action.**  


What You Will Do:

We are seeking a highly analytical and detail\-oriented Senior Financial Analyst to support financial planning, operational analysis, and executive reporting. This role requires a hands\-on professional who can dive deep into financial and operational data, identify drivers of performance, and translate complex variance analysis into actionable insights.  

The ideal candidate will not only explain what happened, but why it happened — and partner with operational leaders to improve margins, cash flow, and overall financial performance. **Key Responsibilities****:** **Planning \& Forecasting*** Support annual budgeting and quarterly forecasting processes.
* Build and maintain financial models/templates to project revenue and margins.
* Develop sensitivity and scenario analysis to assess financial impact of operational decisions.

 **Financial Analysis \& Variance Reporting*** Perform monthly financial close analysis, including detailed revenue, margin, SG\&A for assigned sectors and SG\&A cost centers.
* Experience with inventory and consumables, including cost trends and usage
* Investigate and explain budget vs. actual, forecast vs. actual, and prior year variances.
* Track job\-level performance and contract profitability
* Analyze and track revenue trends to identify drives of change including renewals, contract expansions, new and lost business.
* Evaluate operational KPIs including DSO, DIO, labor efficiency, and cost trends.
* Identify trends, risks, and opportunities and proactively communicate insights to leadership.

 **Operational Partnership*** Partner with operations leaders to understand business drivers and cost structure.
* Analyze labor, material, and overhead variances at a detailed level.
* Evaluate contract performance, margin movement (i.e. margin improvement/erosion), and cost pass\-through dynamics.
* Provide decision support planning through detailed financial analysis, financial modeling and/or scenario analysis.
* Participate in business reviews and provide financial insight to non\-financial stakeholders.

 **Reporting \& Executive Communication*** Prepare executive and board\-level reporting materials with clear and concise commentary.
* Improve reporting processes to enhance accuracy, efficiency, and transparency.

 **Process Improvement \& Controls*** Improve financial reporting processes and data integrity.
* Assist with implementation of new financial tools, reporting structures, or automation initiatives.
* Ensure compliance with accounting policies and internal controls (i.e. invoice and expense report approvals).


What It Takes To Be Successful:
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field.
* 5\+ years of progressive experience in financial analysis, FP\&A, or corporate finance.
* Strong understanding of income statement, balance sheet, and cash flow interdependencies.
* Intermediate to advanced Excel skills require, with demonstrated ability to build financial models, analyze/manipulate data sets, use complex formulas (INDEX/MATCH or XLOOKUP), pivot tables and ability build and calculate scenario analysis.
* Highly motivated, achievement driven, and committed to delivering accurate high\-quality work products
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to apply critical thinking to complex financial and operational issues.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Preferred qualifications: Hands\-on experience with Planful (or similar FP\&A forecasting tools) for budgeting, forecasting, and reporting and ERP systems (e.g. SAP by Design)


Why You Will Love It Here:
* Hybrid work schedule (2\-3 days a week in office or on\-site)
* The satisfaction of driving real change in the industry and people’s lives
* A diverse community of people who are driven by a shared purpose
* A business that acts with integrity in all interactions with co\-workers, leaders, and customers
* We value others and build success by appreciating differences in thought, opinion, background, skills, and perspectives
* An environment of continuous learning and development
* Flat organizational structures which elevate employees’ level of responsibility
* Competitive base salary
*

jobs.description:
**DEPARTMENT OVERVIEW**


The Enterprise Controllership Organization is dedicated to providing high quality information and services to our business partners. We support our business partners from across various Film Studios including Disney Live Action, Walt Disney Animation Studios, Pixar, Marvel, LucasFilm, and 20th Century Studios in their decision\-making process while earning their confidence and respect by efficiently reporting and maintaining accurate and timely financial data. Our vision is to be the global leader in providing financial and technical expertise. We promote innovation and growth by developing our employees and maximizing technology while maintaining a fun environment.

 **JOB DESCRIPTION**


Reporting to the Manager of Production Accounting, the Senior Financial Accounting Analyst (SFAA) will be responsible for production and distribution accounting and reporting, as well as assisting in the oversight of third\-party service providers and providing them with support. The SFAA will be involved in the quarter close and year\-end close processes including but not limited to the analysis of production costs, distribution revenue, overhead and interest expenses, lead close calls with business partners, and the preparation of Studio Financial Reporting deliverables. In addition, the SFAA will work with our Finance counterparts to help ensure that all financial statements are in accordance with US GAAP and to provide accounting support, where needed. This role will also work closely with other internal Disney divisions, including Corporate Controllership, Treasury, Tax, and FP\&A.

 **JOB RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Liaise with business partners for all accounting inquiries including providing technical accounting guidance for new business initiatives
* Provide accounting support and guidance to our third\-party service providers
* Review and analyze financial statements for studio production and distribution business units in order to ensure accuracy and completeness of the financial statements
* Prepare financial statements and variance analysis on a quarterly basis for balance sheet and income statement
* Prepare key quarterly and year\-end financial reporting deliverables and footnote disclosures
* Prepare monthly development and production spending packages for accuracy and provide explanations for any significant variances
* Prepare monthly production cost rollforward’s for multiple business areas
* Prepare overhead and/or interest forecasts on a quarterly basis
* Review and analyze estimated film cost (EFC’s) and provide variance analysis for multiple business areas on a quarterly basis
* Record monthly distribution cash statements and prepare various quarterly accruals
* Manage various ad\-hoc reporting and projects for Senior Management
* Prepare and submit requests related to SOX compliance, tax, and quarter/year\-end financial audits
* Establish an environment of continuous improvement to identify, develop and implement process changes to increase accuracy of our financial records or forecast, and efficiency of our processes
* Assist the Manager of Production Accounting with the review of journal entries and reporting deliverables

 **EDUCATION/CERTIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s degree required (an emphasis in Accounting preferred)
* CPA or CPA candidate preferred
* 3\+ years’ accounting experience, preferably in public accounting and/or entertainment accounting.

 **experience**

* Effective communication skills (written \& verbal)
* Excellent knowledge of accounting principles and internal controls
* Strong quantitative and analytical skills
* Ability to succeed in a team environment
* Customer\-service oriented
* Strong problem solving skills
* Ability to adapt quickly and learn new tasks independently
* Excellent organization skills
* Ability to manage competing priorities
* Ability to analyze and resolve issues from multiple stakeholders
* Ability to oversee and provide guidance to third\-party service providers

  

The hiring range for this position in California is $104,800\.00\-$128,000\.00 per year. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. JOB TITLE: Compliance Analyst

JOB SUMMARY


Will coordinate the compliance oversight activities for Imperial and with first\-tier, downstream, and related entities (FDRs), as necessary, to meet the contractual oversight regulatory requirements for the prevention, detection, and correction of Fraud, Waste and Abuse (FWA) and Medicare program non\-compliance as established by the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS).

You must be able to review a work order and know what specific materials, fasteners, tools, or rental equipment are required.

Your main mission is to accurately scope material needs, source items from our vendors, and coordinate delivery or pickup to maximize field efficiency.

* **Work Order Analysis:** Review daily incoming work orders to determine accurate material takeoffs and equipment requirements across multiple trades (carpentry, tile, drywall, hardware, etc.)

* **Logistics \& Coordination:** Arrange the most efficient delivery method for every job. This includes coordinating field technician pickups, scheduling vendor deliveries directly to retail jobsites, or routing shipments to our Santa Ana warehouse.

You must be familiar with materials/terms related to commercial doors/hardware, drywall, flooring, tiling, and painting etc.

* **Tech Savvy:** Proficient with work order management systems and basic spreadsheets.

jobs.title: Planner/Buyer, Supply Chain
jobs.description:
Aperia is unlocking a new era of efficiency and sustainability for commercial vehicle fleets, by developing innovative hardware and data analytics solutions. Inventors of the award\- winning and disruptive Halotm Automatic Tire Inflator, and the cloud delivered Halo Connect tire analytics platform. Aperia saves fleets thousands of hours of down\-time every week, reduces the carbon footprint and environmental impact of the freight industry. Join us as we expand our product offering and take the next steps on our journey toward bringing the "backbone of our economy" into the automation age.

**We are unable to sponsor H\-1B visas or any other employment\-based visas for this position at this time.**


**Your Role**



As a Planner/Buyer on Aperia's Supply Chain team, you own both the demand and the supply side of your assigned commodity groups, a mix of off\-the\-shelf components and build\-to\-spec parts. You are the day\-to\-day contact for the suppliers and contract manufacturers who make them. Through regular touchpoints you will understand their capacity and constraints as well as they do, and make sure they always know what Aperia needs next. When something slips, a late shipment, a design change, a demand spike, you are the person who sees it first and drives it to resolution.


**Your Responsibilities**


* Translate Aperia's production and sales plans into a demand forecast, applying the planning method that fits each inventory group, MRP, min/max, kanban, or reorder point to support inventory planning.
* Own item master planning parameters in NetSuite (lead times, safety stock, lot sizing, reorder points) by maintaining them accurately so that MRP output is trustworthy enough to act on.
* Place and manage purchase orders from release through receipt, including expediting, de\-expediting, and resolving PO, acknowledgement, and invoice discrepancies to support timely material availability.
* Publish rolling delivery schedules to contract manufacturers so they can level\-load their factories.
* Run shortage and clear\-to\-build reporting; escalate and resolve bottlenecks cross\-functionally before they become line\-down events.
* Partner with Engineering and Quality on engineering change orders, sequencing cut\-in dates, managing run\-out of superseded revisions to minimize excess inventory.
* Manage supplier performance using delivery, quality, and responsiveness data, and bring the data to quarterly business reviews.
* Support inventory health in your commodity groups: cycle count follow\-up, aging and excess/obsolete review, and inventory turns analysis to maintain effective stock levels.
* Support new product introduction by sourcing prototype and pilot builds and setting up new items for production.
* Negotiate pricing, MOQs, lead times, and payment terms within approval limits to support cost and supply objectives.


**Skills/Qualifications**


* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics or related field.
* 3\+ years in purchasing and planning (both preferred), in a manufacturing or hardware environment.
* Hands\-on experience running planning and purchasing in an ERP system such as NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, or Microsoft Dynamics.
* Strong Excel, pivot tables, lookups, and comfort cleaning and analyzing several thousand rows of ERP data without help.
* A track record of resolving supply problems by pulling in the right people, rather than escalating and waiting.
* Clear, direct written communication with suppliers across time zones.
* Ability to work on\-site at our Hayward, CA facility five days per week.

  


**Pay Range: $95,000 \- $105,000**


* Base salary only. Salary is dependent on multiple factors including, but not limited to, experience and location.



\*\*Additional compensation may include equity, bonuses, stipends, medical, dental, vision, 401(k), and long\-term disability insurance.

Instead, you will act as the critical technical bridge between R\&D and the Policy/Risk Control teams and support in managing the critical "data filters" (Gateways) that synchronize information between production environments and external parties. You will dive deep into data lineage, review complex technical requests (including code and SQL), and make high\-stakes compliance decisions in a fast\-paced environment. jobs.title: Senior FP&A Analyst
jobs.description:

Woven Health Collective is a healthcare marketing, strategy, and science communications company, dedicated to revolutionizing healthcare through innovative solutions and collaborative partnerships. Our unwavering commitment to empathy and collaboration ensures that both our team and clients experience a rewarding journey, where innovation not only advances healthcare but also enriches lives.


At Woven Health Collective, you will be empowered to bring your authentic self to work and unlock your full potential. Come join our growing team!


**Job Summary**

Woven Health Collective is seeking an experienced, analytical, and business\-minded FP\&A Senior Analyst to support financial planning, operational performance management, Board reporting, and private equity sponsor requirements.


The FP\&A Senior Analyst will partner with Finance, Accounting, Operations, and business leaders throughout Woven Health Collective to provide timely, accurate, and actionable financial and operational information. This individual will play an important role in helping leaders understand business performance, identify margin\-improvement opportunities, and support the Company’s growth and value\-creation objectives.


The ideal candidate brings at least three to five years of progressive finance experience, strong financial modeling and reporting capabilities, experience supporting Board\-level reporting, and prior exposure to private equity–backed companies or sponsor\-driven performance environments.


**Job Responsibilities and Skills**


***Financial Planning, Budgeting, and Forecasting***


* Partner with the FP\&A Manager to support Woven Health Collective’s annual budgeting process, including coordinating planning timelines, gathering and consolidating departmental submissions, reviewing budget assumptions, and preparing analyses for leadership review.
* Assist with development of annual operating plans, departmental budgets, capital expenditure budgets, headcount plans, utilization targets, and other financial and operational performance targets.
* Support the preparation, maintenance, and refinement of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial forecasts.
* Prepare actual\-versus\-budget, actual\-versus\-forecast, and period\-over\-period variance analyses, including clear explanations of significant financial, operational, and utilization drivers.
* Work with department and operational leaders to understand performance results, identify financial and operational risks and opportunities, and improve the accuracy of planning assumptions.
* Develop and maintain financial models to support budgeting, forecasting, staffing plans, labor planning, utilization planning, capital expenditures, pricing, profitability analysis, strategic initiatives, and other business cases.
* Support the development, monitoring, and communication of key financial and operational performance indicators.


***Utilization and Workforce Performance Management***


* Develop, maintain, and manage utilization reporting and dashboards across applicable teams, departments, locations, service lines, and business units.
* Track and analyze utilization, billable hours, productive hours, capacity, staffing levels, labor productivity, overtime, workload, backlog, and other workforce\-performance metrics, as applicable.
* Monitor actual utilization against established targets, budgets, forecasts, historical performance, and operating plans.
* Support the establishment and refinement of utilization definitions, reporting standards, targets, and accountability measures to improve consistency and visibility across the organization.
* Analyze the financial impact of utilization performance on revenue, labor costs, margins, profitability, patient or client service, and overall operating results.
* Prepare recurring utilization and capacity reporting for operational reviews, executive leadership meetings, Board reporting, and private equity sponsor reporting, as needed.


***Board, Executive, and Private Equity Reporting***


* Prepare recurring financial and operational reporting for Woven Health Collective’s Board of Directors, executive leadership team, and private equity sponsors.
* Assist with the preparation of Board reporting packages, including financial statements, KPI dashboards, utilization data, operating metrics, forecast updates, cash\-flow information, variance analyses, and narrative commentary.
* Develop accurate, clear, and polished executive\-level and Board\-ready presentation materials.
* Ensure all financial and operational information included in Board and executive reporting is accurate, thoroughly validated, and delivered in accordance with established deadlines.

The Center for Green Market Activation™ (GMA) is a US\-based, globally\-focused nonprofit that was launched in June of 2024\. Our vision is to be the global leader in providing financial and technical expertise. We promote innovation and growth by developing our employees and maximizing technology while maintaining a fun environment.

 **JOB DESCRIPTION**


Reporting to the Manager of Production Accounting, the Senior Financial Accounting Analyst (SFAA) will be responsible for production and distribution accounting and reporting, as well as assisting in the oversight of third\-party service providers and providing them with support. The SFAA will be involved in the quarter close and year\-end close processes including but not limited to the analysis of production costs, distribution revenue, overhead and interest expenses, lead close calls with business partners, and the preparation of Studio Financial Reporting deliverables. In addition, the SFAA will work with our Finance counterparts to help ensure that all financial statements are in accordance with US GAAP and to provide accounting support, where needed. This role will also work closely with other internal Disney divisions, including Corporate Controllership, Treasury, Tax, and FP\&A.

 **JOB RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Liaise with business partners for all accounting inquiries including providing technical accounting guidance for new business initiatives
* Provide accounting support and guidance to our third\-party service providers
* Review and analyze financial statements for studio production and distribution business units in order to ensure accuracy and completeness of the financial statements
* Prepare financial statements and variance analysis on a quarterly basis for balance sheet and income statement
* Prepare key quarterly and year\-end financial reporting deliverables and footnote disclosures
* Prepare monthly development and production spending packages for accuracy and provide explanations for any significant variances
* Prepare monthly production cost rollforward’s for multiple business areas
* Prepare overhead and/or interest forecasts on a quarterly basis
* Review and analyze estimated film cost (EFC’s) and provide variance analysis for multiple business areas on a quarterly basis
* Record monthly distribution cash statements and prepare various quarterly accruals
* Manage various ad\-hoc reporting and projects for Senior Management
* Prepare and submit requests related to SOX compliance, tax, and quarter/year\-end financial audits
* Establish an environment of continuous improvement to identify, develop and implement process changes to increase accuracy of our financial records or forecast, and efficiency of our processes
* Assist the Manager of Production Accounting with the review of journal entries and reporting deliverables

 **EDUCATION/CERTIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s degree required (an emphasis in Accounting preferred)
* CPA or CPA candidate preferred
* 3\+ years’ accounting experience, preferably in public accounting and/or entertainment accounting.

 **experience**

* Excellent knowledge of accounting principles and internal controls
* Strong quantitative and analytical skills
* Ability to succeed in a team environment
* Customer\-service oriented
* Strong problem solving skills
* Ability to adapt quickly and learn new tasks independently
* Excellent organization skills
* Ability to manage competing priorities
* Ability to analyze and resolve issues from multiple stakeholders
* Ability to oversee and provide guidance to third\-party service providers

About the Team The Data Governance Engineering team is at the heart of our data strategy. We don't just follow rules; we build the technical guardrails and automated systems that allow the company to innovate safely at scale. About the Role As a Technical Compliance Analyst, you will not be handling repetitive first\-line tickets (which are managed by our outsourced partners). Instead, you will act as the critical technical bridge between R\&D and the Policy/Risk Control teams and support in managing the critical "data filters" (Gateways) that synchronize information between production environments and external parties. You will dive deep into data lineage, review complex technical requests (including code and SQL), and make high\-stakes compliance decisions in a fast\-paced environment. You will also leverage and optimize AI Agents to automate governance workflows and conduct A/B testing on compliance logic. This role is not just about processing tickets or managing SLAs; it is about high\-stakes technical auditing, process engineering, and leveraging automation to secure one of the world’s most complex data ecosystems. Responsibilities: \- Technical Bridge \& Mediation: Serve as the primary technical consultant between Engineering teams and Policy/Risk stakeholders to translate complex legal/compliance requirements into actionable technical specifications. \- Advanced Technical Review: Perform high\-level audits of data access, microservices, and API integrations. You must be able to read and understand code/SQL to identify potential compliance risks that automated scanners might miss. \- Data Lineage \& Scenario Analysis: Rapidly map and understand complex data lineage (data flows) across various business scenarios to ensure end\-to\-end data integrity and regulatory adherence. \- Compliance Decision Making: Make authoritative "Approve/Reject" decisions on complex technical requests within strict SLA windows, balancing business velocity with rigorous risk control. Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities and maintain quality. \- AI\-Driven Governance: Utilize and tune AI Agents to enhance governance efficiency. This includes Context Engineering, prompt optimization, and conducting A/B testing on automated compliance models. \- Risk \& Data Analysis: Conduct deep\-dive data analysis to identify systemic risks, trends, and bottlenecks in the data lifecycle, providing data\-backed recommendations to senior leadership. \- Framework Evolution: Partner with the engineering team to build and refine automated compliance frameworks, moving away from manual checks toward "Compliance\-as\-Code." Develop new and continuously improve existing operational documentation (runbooks, review criteria, escalation paths).

Minimum Qualifications: \- Technical Literacy: Ability to read and interpret code (e.g., Python, Java, or Go) and SQL. You should be comfortable discussing system architecture with developers. \- Analytical Mindset: Proven experience in technical risk analysis or data analysis. You can look at a data flow and pinpoint where the "leak" or "risk" is. \- AI Savvy: Hands\-on experience or strong theoretical knowledge of AI/LLM tools. Familiarity with Context Engineering and the ability to use AI to automate workflow\-related tasks. \- Decision Making: Experience working in a fast\-paced environment where you must make accurate compliance decisions under tight SLAs. High attention to detail, sound judgment, and able to make decisions for approvals or rejections within defined policy boundaries; ability to escalate appropriately when criteria is unclear. \- Strategic Communication and Stakeholder Management: Exceptional ability to explain technical risks to non\-technical policy makers and explain policy constraints to engineers. Serve as one of the primary cross\-functional partners for ticket review operations and data field governance, coordinating with Product, Global Risk and Compliance, and other Engineering teams. Preferred Qualifications \- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field. \- Data Governance Expertise: Strong understanding of data lifecycle management, data lineage, and privacy frameworks (e.g., GDPR, CCPA). \- Experience in Data Engineering or Backend Development before moving into Compliance/Governance. \- Familiarity with Data Catalog tools and automated Metadata management. \- Prior experience in a "Technical Program Manager" or "Data Protection Incident Manager"

new_jobs.title: Project Management Analyst / Scrum Master
new_jobs.description:
Nakupuna Companies is seeking a Project Management Analyst / Scrum Master to support a multidisciplinary Agile DevSecOps team delivering Informatica data\-governance and MuleSoft integration capabilities for NAVSUP Business Systems Center. The individual will provide disciplined Agile facilitation, project analysis, and delivery coordination so the team can convert PWS requirements and Government priorities into transparent, executable, and traceable work.


The individual will facilitate Scrum and SAFe\-like practices; develop and maintain the Agile roadmap, integrated schedule, backlog, dashboards, and project controls in Azure DevOps; coordinate deliverables, risks, dependencies, reviews, and status reporting; and maintain the documentation workflow. The position will work closely with Government representatives, architects, engineers, administrators, cybersecurity personnel, data specialists, and external system stakeholders. Technical and security owners will validate substantive content, and Government officials will retain approval, acceptance, contractual, and funding authority.

  

The following reflects management's definition of essential functions for this job but does not restrict the tasks that may be assigned. Management may assign additional duties and responsibilities to this job at any time due to mission requirements and reasonable accommodation.  

* Facilitate Agile Scrum and SAFe\-like delivery activities, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, team coordination, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and program\-increment planning support, as applicable to NAVSUP practices.
* Develop and maintain the Agile Project Roadmap with the team, including the project scope, prioritized epics and features, integrated master schedule, major milestones and dependencies, PWS\-aligned work breakdown structure, resource plan, communications plan, risk\-management approach, quality\-management approach, change\-control process, and configuration\-management approach.
* Administer the NAVSUP Azure DevOps backlog by decomposing PWS requirements and deliverables into epics, features, user stories or product backlog items, tasks, and defects while maintaining bidirectional traceability to the governing PWS sections and deliverables.
* Maintain current work\-item ownership, estimates, remaining effort, status, start and finish dates, dependencies, acceptance criteria, risks, and approval status; configure dashboards and queries for burn\-down, milestones, deliverables, blocked work, and risk visibility; and prepare required baseline and monthly ADO exports.
* Coordinate work across Informatica, MuleSoft, AWS, database, testing, cybersecurity, documentation, training, and sustainment activities; identify cross\-team dependencies and impediments; maintain action and decision records; and elevate issues promptly with recommended options.
* Maintain the integrated deliverable schedule and review calendar; coordinate owners, contributors, acceptance criteria, draft and final reviews, comment resolution, resubmissions, and Government acceptance records without assuming Government approval authority.
* Prepare the Monthly Status Report and supporting management data, including staffing, accomplishments, completion status, forecast dates, travel, issues and recommended solutions, plan or schedule changes, overdue Government dependencies, staffing adequacy, knowledge\-transfer activity, property status, onboarding, certifications, and required training; coordinate invoice support with authorized contracts and billing personnel.
* Maintain project risks, issues, assumptions, dependencies, changes, configuration\-control actions, and lessons learned; assess schedule and delivery impacts; facilitate mitigation planning; and keep the risk register and related project\-management documentation current.
* Interview technical and cybersecurity subject\-matter experts and develop, edit, organize, trace, and maintain required documentation, including plans, installation and configuration guides, integration runbooks, API specifications, OpenAPI/Swagger artifacts, security evidence, architecture diagrams, backup and recovery materials, training products, governance guides, and configuration records; ensure responsible owners validate technical content.
* Manage document and knowledge repositories in Azure DevOps and associated wikis, including version history, templates, links, review status, publication, and traceability among requirements, work items, evidence, and deliverables.
* Coordinate training and knowledge\-transfer schedules, materials, demonstrations, recordings, attendance records, reports, FAQs, action items, and documentation updates so NAVSUP personnel receive current and maintainable operating information throughout the period of performance.
* Performs other related duties as assigned.

 **Skills/Qualifications****:**


In addition to being able to confidently perform the above job duties, the candidate should demonstrate the following:

* Agile Delivery / Scrum \- Applies servant\-leadership practices, facilitates productive ceremonies, coaches the team on flow and commitments, supports capacity\-based planning, and helps the team continuously improve without assuming the Government Product Owner role.
* Project Analysis / Controls \- Builds usable roadmaps, schedules, work breakdown structures, metrics, dashboards, risk registers, and decision\-ready analyses; recognizes emerging schedule, staffing, dependency, quality, and scope concerns early.
* Communication / Facilitation \- Leads focused working sessions, elicits clear decisions and acceptance criteria, translates between technical and nontechnical stakeholders, documents outcomes, and follows through on commitments and unresolved actions.
